events.name: CPI (MoM)
events.description: Hot CPI → risk-off (crypto down). Cool CPI → risk-on (crypto up).
events.avxBias: Hot CPI could push AVAX from Harvest Mode → Bleeding Edge. Cool CPI → Peak Yield.

events.name: CPI (YoY)
events.description: Same as MoM but market weights the YoY trend more heavily.
events.avxBias: Sustained YoY decline = sustained Harvest Mode+. Sticky YoY = Bleeding Edge risk.

events.name: Core CPI (MoM)
events.description: Core = ex-food/energy. Fed watches this closest. Surprise moves are violent.
events.avxBias: Core hot = Bleeding Edge or Panic Farm. Core cool = Peak Yield zone.
